tag: Episode 6 · Beyond the Mirror, I Know Myself
title: Beyond the Mirror, I Know Myself

beats.t: The reflected Yeoni spread black wings. Not feathers, but layers of broken mirror shards fitted together.
Every shard reflected Yeoni's face. Comparing Yeoni, Jealous Yeoni, Giving-up Yeoni.
Yeoni smiling as though everything was fine. And Yeoni unable to believe in themself.
Wow... I really have a crowded inner staff.
And everyone's more expressive than me. It feels unfair that the original looks the most miserable.
Focus. All of those are Rob Wealth, shaking your place.
But they look like me.
That makes them more dangerous.
Unauthorized use of my face, and unauthorized duplication too. Where do I report a likeness violation?
The reflected Yeoni slowly rose. As the shards behind it rotated, the whole island trembled like a bell.
[ Island of Companions · Final Trial ]
[ Reclaim the self in the mirror. ]
[ On failure, return-to-reality rights will transfer to Mirror Yeoni. ]
Hold on. Transfer of rights?
Yes. Your life account, my login.
That's insane. This is straight-up account theft.
Something like that.
No two-factor authentication?
There was.
The reflected Yeoni pointed to the flower on Yeoni's head.
The Eulhae you just found.
Yeoni held on again to the warmth in their hooves. Eul, a small shoot. Hae, deep water. Both shone faintly, still not fully one.
But it isn't at 100% yet.
A number appeared in the air.
[ Eulhae Day Pillar recovery: 87% ]
Why 87%, specifically? Such an awkward number to make someone anxious.
Eighty-seven percent complete. Like that download bar that looks nearly done but never finishes. That's this.
The last 13% remains.
What is it?
That apparition.
Exactly. Reclaim me, and it's complete.
You?
I'm the you that you cut away because you didn't want to acknowledge it.
So I don't have to beat you...
You have to take me back. Can you do that?
The words were strangely chilling. Breaking it would have been easier. Call it a fake and smash it. But take it back? Let it into themself?
That face was infuriating, its words obnoxious. It picked out every part Yeoni wanted to flee and jabbed at it. Yet in the end, it too was Yeoni.
I really do make my own life difficult.
You do.
The wings spread wide, and black fragments rained down.
Get back!
Golden claws cut the air. Clang, clang, clang. Shards bounced away in every direction.
But broken fragments rejoined. Cut one and there were two; cut two and there were four.
Why are they multiplying?
The more they take, the more they grow. Cutting alone won't end this.
Why are you telling me that now!
Because I'm seeing it now!
Even rolling is hard with legs this short! I'll plant my nose in the ground trying to retreat!
The reflected Yeoni lowered a hand. This time the fragments converged on Yeoni, not Yeongnyangi.
You're late. You're weak. You're always pretending to smile.
There's no place for you. If you can't do it, I will.
The voices burrowed into their ears together. Words Yeoni thought had vanished in Hae's abyss returned. Pretending to be fine. Laughing it off. Running away.
See? You're still wavering.
Yeoni planted a hoof on the ground.
Am I not allowed to waver?
The reflection's eyebrow rose slightly.
You said I'm Eul Wood. A little plant. Isn't swaying normal, then?
...It is.
Wavering doesn't make me fake.
Eul's light strengthened. Green vines grew beneath Yeoni's hooves. Instead of breaking the shards, they bound them tightly and lowered them to the floor one by one. Clatter.
Why aren't you breaking them?
You said that only makes more of you. So I'll tie them up.
Using your brain, are you?
I do use my brain, you know.
Then why were you always late?
That one hurts. Let's discuss it in counseling later.
Talk after we get out. Move now.
I know.
Yeoni planted their hooves more firmly. Blue ripples of Hae spread beneath the floor, supporting the vines' roots. The green vines thickened.

Before, Yeoni would have covered their wavering heart with jokes and pretended to be fine. But that wavering heart and that deep water were both part of them. The flower could live only if they did not push the water away.
Then what about this?
A vast mirror rose behind the reflected Yeoni. Yeoni's reality appeared inside. Their room, a phone on the bed, the Code Destiny app open.
A human Yeoni sat before it, with the same face as the reflection. Yeoni stopped breathing.
What is that?
Synchronization.
[ Connecting to return-to-reality protocol ]
[ Candidate: Yeoni / Candidate: Mirror Yeoni ]
[ Original identity verification remaining: 13% ]
While you hesitate here, I can connect to the real world first.
So it really is account theft!
I told you. If you can't do it, I will.
The Yeoni in the mirrored reality picked up the phone. An [Approve Return] button appeared. Yeoni tried to rush forward, but black shards blocked the way.
No!
Why? You still hate that body.
The reflection pointed to Yeoni's flower-pig body.
Who would recognize you if you returned to reality?
The words were sharp. Pink body, short legs, a flower overhead. The present Yeoni was so unlike the Yeoni of the real world.
If I go back, nobody will think anything is wrong. I have your face.
The Yeoni in the mirrored room placed a finger over the button. Yeoni's flower shook. The light of Eulhae shook too.
Yeoni.
Yeoni closed their mouth. It was not wrong. Same face, voice, memories. A Yeoni who never wavered or ran late might be better. For one very brief moment, that thought occurred.
But then they remembered what they had seen in Hae's abyss. Nights pretending to be fine. Unsent words. Feelings endured alone. And the small flower that had bloomed in that deep water.
Yeoni slowly breathed in.
No.
No what?
You are my face.
The flower shone overhead. Vines extended beneath their hooves.
You know my voice and my memories. But you don't know why I laughed.
What?
Why I pretended I was fine. Why I couldn't speak. Why I was late. Why I fell apart alone.
Blue ripples flowed beneath the vines.
You only recite it like a correct answer. You don't feel the pain. That's why you aren't me.
The airborne mirrors shook. In the mirror of reality, the [Approve Return] button flickered.
Then what am I?
The question sounded angry, but also a little hurt. Yeoni caught that note and stepped forward.
You're the me I tried to throw away.
The me that pretends to be perfect. The me that pretends not to be hurt.
The me that tried to stand there looking okay in my place.
Then break me!
The black mirror wings spread wide.
You have to break me to win!
The fragments rushed in again. Yeongnyangi started forward, but Yeoni spoke first.
No.
Green vines grew like a wall. Instead of piercing the fragments, they enfolded them.
I won't break you.
What?
If I erase you, I'll just be pretending not to see the parts I wanted to throw away. Again.
The words echoed across the island. One by one, the mirrors stopped. For the first time, the reflected Yeoni had nothing to say.
Yeoni approached slowly. Honestly, they were afraid. The fake could attack at any moment. The return button still flashed; the wings were still sharp. Yet Yeoni did not stop.
The flower overhead shone. Eul was warm inside their hooves; Hae quietly supported them deep in their chest. Yeoni stopped before the reflection.
Human face and flower-pig face looked at one another.
If you accept me, you'll waver again.
I know.
You'll compare yourself again. Be jealous again. Pretend you're fine again.
Maybe I will.
Even so?
Even when that version of me appears, I won't pretend I don't know it anymore.
The reflection's eyes trembled. Yeoni held out a hoof.
So come on.
The reflected Yeoni looked down at it.
It's not even a hand.
Does that matter right now?
It is a little funny.
I know. Hurry up and take it. This is embarrassing.
The reflected Yeoni gave a tiny laugh. This time it was not mocking. A little irritating, a little tired, a little relieved. A laugh that truly sounded like Yeoni.
The reflection reached out. Its palm touched Yeoni's hoof.
The black wings scattered into fragments. Crash! But it did not hurt. It sounded like an old shell falling away.
The reflected Yeoni's body dissolved into light and slowly seeped into Yeoni.
Yeoni closed their eyes. The feelings of comparison, envy, wanting to do well, trying not to lose, pretending to be fine—all rushed in together.
They were strange and uncomfortable, yet all belonged to Yeoni. Instead of pushing them away, Yeoni simply breathed in. Like deep water. Then breathed out softly. The petals stirred.
[ Original identity verified: 100% · Return-to-reality rights: Yeoni ]
[ Island of Companions final trial complete ]
[ Rob Wealth purified · Friend fragments acquired ]
Congratulations, Yeoni.
Did you just say my name?
I knew it all along.
After treating me like a user this whole time?
Now there is no need to distinguish you.
Three of the broken shards flew before Yeoni. Red, silver, and blue.
These fragments will support you from within now. They have become Friends.
Items?
Closer to talismans.
Great. Into the inventory.
You won't find an inventory, however hard you look.
Ugh, seriously unfriendly UI.
Not unfriendly. Simply nonexistent.
The three shards circled the flower on Yeoni's head, then attached themselves like small petal ornaments. A red petal, a silver petal, a blue petal.
I feel kind of upgraded.
The power of Companions. Now, when you waver, you will be a little better at distinguishing the voices that support you from those that bring you down.
Oh. So I've got a mental filter now?
In very simple terms, yes.
Nice. Could've used that in everyday life too.
The whole island trembled. Mirrors rose into the sky; cracks opened in the black glass floor. Green and blue light rose together from beneath it.
Eulhae. Two characters floated before Yeoni, like a little shoot rooted in deep water. This time they did not feel strange. They felt like a name fitting exactly at the center of their heart.
The Eulhae Day Pillar.
The two characters seeped into their chest. Warmth and cold spread together. Strange, but not uncomfortable. The little flower bloomed more clearly.
[ Four Pillars characters recovered · Day Pillar: 乙亥 ]
[ Day Pillar imprinted · Eulhae no longer requires recovery ]
Did I really clear the first stage?
Yes. You passed the first gate.
What's the reward?
You just received it.
Anything more tangible? Coins, maybe?
No.
This world's economy needs work.
At least tell me where customer support is so I can request a refund. ...Oink.
Yeongnyangi sighed. But there was a very small smile at the corner of his mouth.
Then a sound came from far away. Boom. Boom. Boom. At first like a heartbeat, then a rhythm. A beat, music, cheering crowds.
Yeoni raised their head. Beyond the Island of Companions, now clear of mist, an entirely different island glittered. Colored lanterns, dancing shadows, delicious smells, songs rising into the sky.
Wait. What is that? It smells incredible over there.
My nose reacted first. My nostrils are flaring all by themselves. ...Oink.
The next island.
Does it have food?
Food, songs, and a stage.
Oh. Finally, the cozy part?
Yeongnyangi did not answer. His silence was a little ominous.
Why aren't you answering?
The Island of Expression.
Expression?
Expression, words, talent, the pleasure of eating, the power to create. An island of energy flowing from within you to the outside.
So an island for eating, talking, and singing?
Roughly.
Sounds good.
On the surface.
That tone again. You're making me nervous.
The lotus-leaf boat floated back onto the river. The Island of Companions slowly receded behind them.
At that moment, a black feather fell through the distant sky above the Island of Expression. As it landed on the highest stage, the music cut off abruptly.
...Not the cozy part, then?
Apparently not.
Yeoni felt Eulhae within their chest. A small shoot and deep water. Their center, just reclaimed. They lifted a short hoof.
Okay. Let's take the next road too.
Ready to go?
Yeoni looked at the Island of Expression. Still afraid, but less unsteady than before.
Yeah. But please tell me I won't have to go onstage in a pig's body this time.
Yeongnyangi did not answer.
Hey. Why aren't you answering?
You'll see when we arrive.
Now I'm really worried.
[ Entering Island Two · The Island of Eating God and Hurting Officer ]
The lotus-leaf boat glided toward song and light. And on the stage, the black feather still lay quietly.
